cards.note: Concrete poles with holes running up to 75% of the height of it are found almost exclusively in northern Vietnam. Note: there is poles that holes goes up to 50% of the height all over Vietnam.
Central A-shaped top is where you can see an A standing on the crossbar. It can be centered or off to the side. It is almost exclusively found in central Vietnam.
Greenhouses can be found in Đà Lạt valley.
Dragonfruit plantations are most common in Bình Thuận, but can be found all over the south.

Low-lying, agricultural plains sometimes accompanied with canals are common around Nam Định and southern Hanoi.

Note: You can also find canals max south of the country but they will have different landscape.

One sided top is where the pole has the crossbar on one side with a single diagonal support beam. It can either be completely on one side or uneven to one side. Important to note that you should not confuse it with trapezoid support which has an extra horizontal segment in the support beam.

It is almost exclusively found in the far south.
Pepper planations are most commonly found in Dak Nong, Dak Lak, and Gia Lai provinces.
Plain concrete poles without holes or pinholes are almost exclusively found in northern part of the country.

Rubber tree plantations are primarily found in the provinces to the north of Ho Chi Minh City, as well as in several parts of the Central Highlands.

Rubber trees can be recognized by their thin trunks. In Vietnam, it is typical for a section of the tree trunk to be wrapped in a piece of plastic. These trees tend to be neatly organized in a dense grid-like pattern.
Lamp mounted to the side of the pole with 2 brackets is only found in the region shown on second image.
Canals are very commonly found in the Mekong Delta. Canals can also be found in the north, but the landscape is very different.
Mounted spools are spools mounted directly to the pole. It is almost exclusive to the far south of the country .
Traditional architecture can mostly be found in the north, but can be seen in Đắk Lắk and Gia Lai. The landscape will generally be flatter in those two areas, which can be a good clue for that area.

When two supports of the main crossbar of the pole form triangle it should put you south of the country.

There is similar support that looks like trapezoid so make sure it's actually triangle.

Note: I found those poles rarely north but there was always some other clue to know it's not south.
Poles with 3 half trapezoid supports on a side are exclusively found in the North of the country.

Meter Box Designs with trap door style windows plus ventilation slits on the sides are very common in the province of Khanh Hoa. It can be found everywhere in the province from rural villages to coastal areas.

Note: Other regular Meter box designs can be found throughout the whole country.
